entities.summary: Mohamed Samsoudine Dabone is a Burkinabé basketball player who plays as a center for FC Barcelona Bàsquet. He was born on October 21, 2011 and currently stands at 6 ft 11 in, although his age and nationality are contested. He was promoted to Barcelona's first team in August 2025 and is considered a future NBA prospect, drawing comparisons to Victor Wembanyama and Giannis Antetokounmpo.
